properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF-garages pass: real OSM building footprint for UCSF's Third Street Garage, 1650 3rd St -- 8 levels per OSM tagging, originally designed by Stanley Saitowitz/Natoma Architects; its exterior channel-glass facade was replaced in 2021 with IwamotoScott's 'Cellular Origami' aluminum-panel facade.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. Same situation as this project's other UCSF Mission Bay campus buildings: UCSF is state land, not carried in DataSF's Assessor secured tax roll (no blklot to join), so the real building footprint is the correct non-fabricated geometry.
